paper.core_task: Benchmarking multimodal large language models on low-level visual perception and understanding

contributions.name: A benchmark for low-level perception ability of MLLMs
contributions.author_claim_text: We build a benchmark for MLLMs on low-level perception ability. To achieve this, we construct a first-of-its-kind balanced and comprehensive LLVisionQA dataset with 2,990 images with one low-level-related question-answer pair for each image.
contributions.description: A new VQA dataset, LLVisionQA, is constructed with 2,990 images and questions covering diverse low-level visual concerns to evaluate the perception ability of MLLMs.

contributions.name: A benchmark process for low-level description ability of MLLMs
contributions.author_claim_text: We define a benchmark process to evaluate the low-level description ability of MLLMs, including an LLDescription dataset of 499 images with expert-labelled long golden quality descriptions, and a GPT-assisted evaluation.
contributions.description: A benchmark process and the LLDescribe dataset of 499 images with expert-written golden descriptions are introduced to evaluate the low-level description ability of MLLMs using GPT-assisted scoring.

contributions.name: A softmax-based quality prediction strategy for MLLMs
contributions.author_claim_text: To evaluate precise quality assessment ability, we propose a unified softmax-based quality prediction strategy for all MLLMs based on their probability outputs.
contributions.description: A unified strategy using softmax pooling on the logits of 'good' and 'poor' tokens is proposed to enable MLLMs to produce quantifiable quality scores for image quality assessment.
